note: Version 2, written on 2026-09-27 AFTER trial-v1 and applying only to later trials. Version 1 (improve/gate_rules_v1.json, fingerprint recorded in improve/trial-v1/gate_result.json) decided trial-v1.
changes_in_v2: Added guard no_broad_decline (max_seeds_worse = 1): trial-v1 was promoted on one extra success (seed 103) although v1 scored lower on 4 of 5 seeds (median -36%). With 5 seeds and rare successes, one success must not outweigh worse play on most seeds.
adapted_from_spec: Cost is measured per tic survived, not per episode: in survival scenarios a better agent lives longer and makes more calls.
A paired-score route is added to 'better play': survival scenarios rarely reach full success, so 5 seeds seldom differ in successes.
Regression cases are asked 3 times and pass on 2 votes: the hosted model is not fully repeatable at temperature 0 (seen 9/27).
v1 must keep every case v0 passes and fix at least one more, instead of passing all cases (v0 passes 4/11).
